description: This file contains security-related functions for JWT token creation, password hashing, user authentication, and role-based access control within a FastAPI application.

methods.name: verify_password
methods.description: Verify a plain-text password against a hashed password.

methods.name: get_password_hash
methods.description: Hash a password using passlib's bcrypt.

methods.name: _create_token
methods.description: Create a JWT token with a subject and expiration delta.

methods.name: create_access_token
methods.description: Generate an access token for the given user ID.

methods.name: create_refresh_token
methods.description: Generate a refresh token for the given user ID.

methods.name: decode_token
methods.description: Decode a JWT token and return its payload, handling expiration and invalid token errors.

methods.name: get_current_user
methods.description: FastAPI dependency that retrieves the current authenticated user based on the bearer token.

methods.name: require_roles
methods.description: Dependency factory enforcing that the current user has one of the allowed roles.

methods.name: require_roles_demo_aware
methods.description: Like require_roles but allows any authenticated user when DEMO_MODE is true.
